fences.rule: If the thing separates the expert from the imitation, it is Kept tell there; if it ranks the domain's failures by what would make everything else moot, it is First look here.
fences.case: The sailor who goes below to look at the bilge before greeting anyone.

fences.rule: If the errors are sorted by whether they can be undone, it is Fatal class there; if the sort is what the domain dismisses a person for on the first occurrence, it is Firing offense here, and where the two diverge the divergence is the reading.
fences.case: The leaked memo, fully reversible, that gets one fired while the surgeon's irreversible honest complication is forgiven.

fences.rule: If the precision marks one domain against other domains, it is Native tolerance there; if it compares quantities inside one domain to find where the money or the danger lives, it is Costly precision here.
fences.case: The machinist's thousandth against the framer's eighth, read as what marks the trade.

fences.rule: There a domain's wreck fossilizes into rules a stranger reads off the rulebook; here the same wreck fossilizes into legibility, a drill an afternoon can read, and the outside judge is the path by which another domain's wreck arrives as a drill run for the record.
fences.case: The disaster-recovery drill imported after someone else's wreck, run for the record and never failed.

fences.rule: If what survives three reorganizations was invisible or feared and nobody can say what would break, it is an obsolete power persisting by habit there; if it was inspected each time and left, it is a load-bearing Reorg survivor here.
fences.case: The committee nobody abolished because nobody remembered it existed.

fences.rule: If the absence halts the work because the domain never bought a spare, it is Halting absence here; if it halts because the indispensable person made herself so by hoarding, it is immunity by entanglement there and the halt marks a hostage.
fences.case: The one clerk who alone can run the billing system because she kept it so.
